requirements.description: A 53-card single-hand draw profile contains exactly one wild joker, reload-safe holds, Kings-or-Better qualification, and distinct natural royal, five-of-a-kind, and wild royal paytable rows.
requirements.notes: Issue #77 allocates the permanent distinct rules requirement for issue #130.

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own private reload-safe source hands, hold selections, durable receipts, settled history, and canonical route restoration.
requirements.notes: Session context overrides caller player ids, unused draw cards remain private, and committed results survive reload and process restart.

requirements.description: One wager debit and at most one returned-token payout credit use the shared ledger exactly once under durable deal and draw action identities.
requirements.notes: No game code mutates balances directly and conflicting retries fail closed.

requirements.description: Joker Poker supplies complete English and Russian responsive, accessible, reduced-motion-safe, timer-clean play.
requirements.notes: Evidence covers both locales and every governed viewport.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, and long-suite discovery include Joker Poker with requirement, module, version, and visual traceability.
requirements.notes: Descriptor sort order 300 and the catalog-discovered long driver are canonical.

requirements.description: Joker Poker publishes active hands, reload-safe holds, recovery markers, bounded terminal history, and durable deal/draw receipts through provider-current callbacks that replace only game-owned fields. Competing processes preserve unrelated player-state siblings and fail closed before a stale draw can overwrite or resurrect the winning hand, while wager and payout recovery retain the frozen v1 behavior and exactly-once ledger movements.
requirements.notes: The frozen v1 contract, 53-card deck, card ordering, hold rules, paytable, ledger transaction types, and action keys remain unchanged. Production multiworker activation stays blocked because wallet and game-state publication remain separate durable boundaries.
